semantic.justification: Task202 exposes actual scalar ODFF symbol entries, including both textual minus opcodes, for the common compiler and Calc scanner. Full symbol/localization/function resources remain unsupported. Other grammars/localized symbol services,functions/names/external/range/matrix/table references and missing-argument rewrite services remain unsupported. Compiler string token output does not imply string-expression evaluation. Localized empty-code errors reject explicitly. ODS filters and UI are not implemented by this task; no broad native parity is certified.
